play: await CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner);

desc_zh: 在你的回合结束时，受到{DisintegrationPower:diff()}点伤害。
desc_en: At the end of your turn, take {DisintegrationPower:diff()} damage.

desc_zh: 每回合少抽{MindRotPower:diff()}张牌。
desc_en: Draw {MindRotPower:diff()} fewer {MindRotPower:plural:card|cards} each turn.

desc_zh: 你在每个回合不能打出超过{SlothPower:diff()}张牌。
desc_en: You cannot play more than {SlothPower:diff()} {SlothPower:plural:card|cards} each turn.

desc_zh: 每回合失去{WasteAwayPower:diff()}点{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。
desc_en: Gain {WasteAwayPower:diff()} less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} per turn.
